solution.text:
HCl: Strong acid (low pH)
NH4Cl : Salt of weak base + strong acid → it gives acidic solution. (pH less than 7)
NaCl: Salt of strong base + strong base → it gives neutral solution with pH = 7.
NaCl: Salt of strong base + weak acid → it gives basic solution with pH > 7.
Thus the increasing order of pH is
HCl<NH4Cl<NaCl<NaCN
